name: Dependence
overview: Scripture reveals that true dependence is found in trusting the Lord who sustains and protects His people, as He neither slumbers nor allows their footing to be moved. Believers receive new life and enduring nourishment through faith in Christ, the bread from heaven, who promises everlasting life to those who believe in Him. Abiding in Christ is essential, for apart from Him, we can do nothing, emphasizing our complete reliance on His presence and power. This dependence leads to a life marked by praise and fruitfulness, glorifying God through steadfast trust.
